company.name: Texel
company.shortDescription: Texel, Inc. is a developer of software solutions for size recommendation & virtual try-on and manufacturer of full-body 3D scanners.
company.description:
Texel, Inc. is a developer of software solutions for size recommendation & virtual try-on and manufacturer of professional full-body 3D scanners for acquiring 3D models and anthropometric surveys.

In January 2021 Texel has presented a scalable AI-backed web-widget for size recommendation and virtual try-on. 
Proprietary deep learning and computer vision technology instantly creates a photorealistic user ‘avatar’ from a single photo, which opens unlimited style exploration.
Machine learning algorithms based on a unique dataset of full-body 3D scans predict accurate user body measurements with 5 simple questions (gender, height, weight, age and body type).


Body scanners:
Texel Portal MX is one of the worlds most popular full-body scanners sold to over 25 countries.

- Complete automation of all processes
- Instant visualization of scan results
- Easy to transport and assemble
- Unmatched stability
- Operational efficiency
- Predictability of key business processes
- Ideal value for money
- Patented software
- Certified

productsAndServices.description: Full-body, full-color 3D scanning systems for people and large objects. Portal scanners automate image capture and produce detailed digital 3D models for measurement, visualization, printing, and digital experiences.
productsAndServices.name: Texel Portal 3D Scanners

productsAndServices.description: Cloud software that processes 3D scanner data into detailed human or object models. It supports model visualization, body analysis, sharing, export, and integration with downstream digital services.
productsAndServices.name: Texel Cloud

productsAndServices.description: AI-based size recommendation and virtual try-on software for fashion retail. It uses body data and garment information to help shoppers select sizes and visualize clothing without a conventional fitting room.
productsAndServices.name: Digital Fitting Room

productsAndServices.description: Computer-vision software that estimates body measurements from photographs taken with a standard smartphone. It supports retail sizing, fitness tracking, and remote custom-tailoring workflows without dedicated scanning equipment.
productsAndServices.name: Texel Mobile Measure

productsAndServices.description: A 3D body-data solution for workplace safety and labor protection. It uses digital body models and measurements to support the assessment and selection of workwear and protective equipment.
productsAndServices.name: Texel Uniform 3D+

productsAndServices.description: A fitness and body-progress application that creates a 3D representation of a person and displays changes in body shape and dimensions over time.
productsAndServices.name: Texel 101Fit
